runtime_recommendations.translation_match: Exact dictionary match only; do not apply word replacement to arbitrary sentences. Only mutate app-owned text nodes/title/placeholder. Keep leading/trailing whitespace and embedded newlines. Keep counts/file names/model IDs unchanged in known anchored dynamic patterns.
runtime_recommendations.react_safety: Do not assign innerHTML or parent textContent. Mutate a text node only after its protected-content ancestors are checked. Preserve DOM structure, SVG icons, values, event handlers and data attributes. Do not collapse nested buttons or spans.
runtime_recommendations.observe: MutationObserver can translate newly rendered app-owned static nodes. Ignore own writes and remember original English when React rerenders or language changes.
runtime_recommendations.aria_compatibility: Root decided to preserve every aria-label in English. Bundle uses document.querySelector(`[aria-label="New project"]`) and button[aria-label^="Actions for "] for focus restoration. Translating these can break keyboard/dialog behavior; other unknown machine selectors may exist. Visible UI/title/placeholder remains translated, accessibility labels intentionally retain English.
runtime_recommendations.protected_selector_caveat: Do not skip the entire [data-chat-thread], .session-project-row or [data-wall-name] subtree: they also contain static app controls. Skip exact user-body/name descendants and preserve data attribute values. The read-only .cm-placeholder UI can remain eligible while .cm-content/live editor data is protected.
runtime_recommendations.brand_names: Do not map a brand to a translated identity. Agent is an explicit UI label retained as Agent.

important_scoping_notes: [data-wall-name] is metadata on the entire .home-startbar and some app-owned Add/Use buttons. Preserve its value, but do not exclude that entire ancestor subtree.
Root permits only the read-only .cm-placeholder[contenteditable=false][aria-hidden=true] as a translated app-owned placeholder; .cm-content/live editor values and submitted messages remain protected.
Show ${i.label} must only expand known application categories. Do not build a generic Show replacement for arbitrary user media titles.
New to this? is an independent app-owned Text node; translation must preserve the adjacent Take the step by step button content and icon.
Generated sound / Camera moves / Characters are app-configured feature labels on banner art. The video prefill scripts and media identifiers remain unchanged.
